title: The Bassment's hotspots (generated by tools/trial/make_hotspots.py from passages.json: do not edit)

on_success.caption: The rungs ring under your boots.
You pocket the advice and start down.
You slip by between two bursts.
You slide through untouched and spot a gap that skips the rest of the run.
You are a little crispier, but you can walk.
Stone scrapes your shoulders, then opens out.

on_defeat.caption: The moth smothers you in a cloud of dust, and you sneeze until the lights go out.

on_failure.caption: Wings buffet your face and powder fills your eyes. Blink it clear and go again.

on_success.caption: You pull the door shut on the dust.

on_defeat.caption: The eel coils round you and the whole room goes white, then black.

on_failure.caption: A bolt of blue arcs across the water and your arm tingles to the elbow. Get your timing back.

on_defeat.caption: The spores take hold, and you become, gently and permanently, part of the farm.

on_defeat.caption: Your twin plays you out, step by step, until the only reflection left in the glass is its own.

on_defeat.caption: Gristle picks you up by the collar, carries you up forty flights of stairs, and sets you gently on the pavement.

on_failure.caption: A hand the size of a bass bin shoves you back across the floor. 'Try again,' says Gristle, without malice.
